components.name: TextTitle
components.when_to_use: the one line the shot is about — an opening title, the subject being named, or a figure written out as words ('14,2 MILHOES km2'). `sub` is the quiet line under it: a pronunciation, a translation, a date
components.when_not_to_use: a passage where one phrase matters more than the rest (TextHighlight); labelling where we are while the shot continues (TextPlace); naming a person (TextName)

sub.description: a pronunciation, translation or date, set small under the title

position.description: leave it centred unless the shot needs the middle kept clear

size.description: `big` is a title filling the frame; `medium` is a label that lets the shot carry on

background.description: paint the lockup as chips instead of bare type — a coloured tag whose colour the theme decides. Say nothing and the theme decides whether there is one at all; most themes leave it off, because bare type on the shot is what this pack is for

components.name: TextPlace
components.when_to_use: the footage already shows a location and the viewer only needs it named — a corner label that does not interrupt the shot
components.when_not_to_use: the viewer needs to know WHERE the place is rather than what it is called (SatelliteLocate); the place is the subject of the whole shot and deserves the frame (TextTitle)

country.description: the wider region, set small under the place

position.description: the default keeps it clear of captions; move it only to dodge something in the shot

size.description: `big` is a title filling the frame; `medium` is a label that lets the shot carry on

background.description: paint the lockup as chips instead of bare type — a coloured tag whose colour the theme decides. Say nothing and the theme decides whether there is one at all; most themes leave it off, because bare type on the shot is what this pack is for

components.name: TextName
components.when_to_use: introducing a person by name while the narration continues; `role` is who they were
components.when_not_to_use: a person's words rather than their name (TextHighlight); the name IS the title card (TextTitle); a lower third with a plate and a rule is wanted (NamePlate)

role.description: what they did or were, set small under the name

position.description: the lower-third corner; move it only to dodge something in the shot

size.description: `big` is a title filling the frame; `medium` is a label that lets the shot carry on

background.description: paint the lockup as chips instead of bare type — a coloured tag whose colour the theme decides. Say nothing and the theme decides whether there is one at all; most themes leave it off, because bare type on the shot is what this pack is for

components.name: TextHighlight
components.when_to_use: a sentence or passage on screen where ONE phrase is the point — `mark` names that phrase and the rest of the line drops back behind it
components.when_not_to_use: the whole line matters equally (TextTitle); several phrases need marking, or the marks should land one after another (HighlightedPassage); the words are a quotation being attributed (QuoteBlock)

mark.description: must be an exact substring of `text`; everything outside it dims

label.description: a quiet second line under the passage — a source, a date, a qualifier

position.description: leave it centred unless the shot needs the middle kept clear

size.description: `big` is a title filling the frame; `medium` is a label that lets the shot carry on

background.description: paint the lockup as chips instead of bare type — a coloured tag whose colour the theme decides. Say nothing and the theme decides whether there is one at all; most themes leave it off, because bare type on the shot is what this pack is for

components.name: TextTag
components.when_to_use: a line of text that none of the role entries fit — a duration, a rank, a count, a caption — with an optional label under it. The general-purpose entry: it does not know what it is saying, so YOU choose where it sits
components.when_not_to_use: the line is one of the four things that carry their own placement: a title or a figure written as words (TextTitle), a location (TextPlace), a person (TextName), a passage with one phrase lifted out (TextHighlight). Reach for a role entry whenever one fits — it puts the text where that kind of text belongs without being asked

label.description: a quiet second line under it

position.description: no role means no default worth trusting — say where it goes

size.description: `big` is a title filling the frame; `medium` is a label that lets the shot carry on

background.description: paint the lockup as chips instead of bare type — a coloured tag whose colour the theme decides. Say nothing and the theme decides whether there is one at all; most themes leave it off, because bare type on the shot is what this pack is for

components.name: TextCounter
components.when_to_use: the narration lands a single figure worth dwelling on and it should be written onto the shot rather than shown on a card — '$7.9 trillion', '29,000 tanks', '70%'. The number counts up to its value
components.when_not_to_use: the figure belongs on a graphic with a plate and a rule (AnimatedCounter); two figures being compared (ComparisonSplit) or three and more (BarChart); a number already written out as words, which is just text (TextTitle)

prefix.description: sits tight against the figure, e.g. a currency symbol

suffix.description: follows the figure — spaced when it is a word ('Trillion'), tight when it is a sign ('%')

decimals.description: authored precision, which outranks the theme's number format

label.description: what the figure counts, set small under it. Omit it when the narration names the figure in the same breath

size.description: `big` is a figure filling the frame; `medium` is a corner readout

background.description: paint the lockup as chips instead of bare type — a coloured tag whose colour the theme decides. Say nothing and the theme decides whether there is one at all; most themes leave it off, because bare type on the shot is what this pack is for
